assumptions: the native covariance is exactly C (L^2) and the row operator is exactly R (sr^-1)
the aperture functional is the signed vector t = [1, -1/2] on the leaf domain
the leaf covariance is R C R^T, computed by the same single R that acts on the signal
the shared latent is one random variable; splitting it changes the covariance
condition: fixed linear model, one shared Gaussian latent, no model bias
estimand: leaf covariance matrix R C R^T and the signed aperture variance t^T (R C R^T) t
goal: Exercise the public matrix path: storage.copy / make_action / make_covariance / apply / transpose_apply / covariance_apply / quadratic_form on an explicit rational matrix, and falsify the 'split a shared source into independent pieces' shortcut.

independence.note: truth is produced before and independently of any observed run

negative_expectations.expectation: treating the shared latent as independent must NOT reproduce the truth; the false value must differ by more than the tolerance
an output array must not decode to zeros

positive_expectations.expectation: t^T R C R^T t equals 277/64
quadratic_form(C_native, R^T t) equals the leaf-domain value

unit: leaf variance (L^2 sr^-2); aperture variance (L^2 sr^-2)
